analysis: The chronological next-item trial completed successfully but reduced macro validation HR@10 to 0.4425, versus 0.5125 for the latest reconstruction trial and the recorded best of 0.5363. Per-category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.490, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.590, Electronics 0.355, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.335. These results do not support replacing reconstruction with this sampled-prefix objective under the retained configuration. Possible causes include less supervision from one target per example, a changed cross-entropy-to-KL balance, and the difference between sampled training prefixes and full-history inference; this trial does not isolate their effects.
code_summary: Per-category MultVAE with a recency-weighted, L2-normalized EmbeddingBag encoder, hidden size 256, latent size 64, dropout 0.5, Gaussian posterior, and nonlinear decoder. Training uniformly samples a chronological prefix boundary per eligible user and predicts the next item with full-catalog cross-entropy, excluding padding while allowing repeated-item targets. The unchanged KL term anneals to 0.2. Inference uses full histories, deterministic posterior means, and candidate decoder scores. All four dataset routes and the matching predictor writer are retained.
